tools.name: list_options
tools.description: List the country codes and sector codes supported by the salary benchmarks, with each country's currency.

tools.name: get_salary_benchmark
tools.description: Get the gross average annual salary for a country and sector, based on OECD and Eurostat public data.

tools.name: compare_salary
tools.description: Compare a gross annual salary with the country and sector benchmark, returning whether it is below, near, or above the benchmark and by what percentage.
